name: THE HOTEL'S LAMP
note: EXTRACTED from docs/118-objects-the-lines.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 245). Do not edit: change doc 118 and re-run. Taken from Thad's room in Act IV for the dig; kept.

LOOK_AT.say: The hotel's lamp, trimmed low by management and carried off by a guest. I mean to bring it back.
repeat: Half a reservoir of oil. Enough for forty feet down, if I am not sentimental about the way up.
The notice was tacked beside it, not to it. I have complied with the notice.

LISTEN_TO.say: The flame, eating quietly. It has better manners than the pickaxe.
repeat: Oil, moving in the glass when I walk.
A small flutter. It does not care for holes.
